what: Bust shape variants on the v2 body. One shape key 'figure_bust' on the body (the baked base stays Basis) and a matching key on every garment/strap/pendant/hair piece within 8 cm of the chest. volume = ratio of the added volume to the adopted base's bust mound (the solver scales the mound until the whole change, every term included, hits it); lift_deg = upward rotation of the mass about a hinge hinge_frac of the way up the base; projection = extra stretch along the base normal as a fraction of the height above the plane; raise_m = straight-up translation of the mass; fill_* = an upper-pole bump above the mound (heights below the shoulder-joint line, metres; 1 px at 144 = 13.2 mm) so the top grows out of the chest as a ramp; under_* = the same kind of bump just under the underbust fold. Units: metres and degrees.
